annotation.description: The video is an underwater scene. In the background there is a ship wreck. There are a lot of air bubbles from divers. On the top of the video appears the hands of a diver in the beginning. In the later part of the video we see a diver by the ship wreck dressed in a black wetsuit with silver scuba tank. The ground is sand and the video is quite dark overall. The camera gets closer to the wreck during the video.
